verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official Python SDK, with installation, `init()` configuration, `bento.track_ai`, `flush()` and a Google ADK extra. For JS/TS, the evidence only shows sending traces through standard OpenTelemetry JSON exporters 'without installing any Bento package', so an official JS/TS SDK is not evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented official JS/TS SDK package, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either SDK.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: Wrap any LLM or tool call with bento.track_ai.
JavaScript's OpenTelemetry exporters can emit JSON, so you can send traces to Bento without installing any Bento package.
